2026_02_PHI_TEN.headline: Philadelphia’s reshuffled interior gets a Jeffery Simmons stress test
2026_02_PHI_TEN.paragraph1: Philadelphia travels to Tennessee with Landon Dickerson on injured reserve, making the Eagles’ interior protection a focal point against Jeffery Simmons. Jalen Carter and Cooper DeJean are available, but Jonathan Greenard remains out, leaving Philadelphia to generate pressure without one of its edge pieces. Tennessee needs Cam Ward to stay composed against Vic Fangio’s coverage structure, while the Eagles can lean on Jalen Hurts’ mobility and a balanced offense if their replacement guard rotation holds up.
2026_02_PHI_TEN.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s advantage depends on keeping interior disruption from derailing Hurts, while Tennessee needs Ward to avoid obvious passing downs against a coverage unit built to punish hesitation.
